sourceRegister.title: HumDes Human Design Gate Reference Articles (64-gate physiology audit)
limitations: Source-attributed gate physiology labels are not experimentally validated gate mechanisms.
The catalog includes endocrine-relevant tissue assignments and selected non-endocrine entries where needed to preserve source disagreement; excluded pages remain documented in the source register.
The physiology scope is based on biomedical literature and does not imply that a named gate has biological control over the tissue or its hormones.
sourceRegister.sourceScope: All 64 individual HumDes gate reference pages were inventoried for their physiology field. The included subset retains source assignments to classical endocrine glands and other tissues with documented hormone production or endocrine secretion (including liver, heart, kidney, stomach, and intestine), plus four non-endocrine assignments (Gates 4, 24, 43, and 47) to preserve visible source-specific differences. Other page assignments were reviewed but excluded from this endocrine-focused catalog because their named targets are not a direct endocrine source/tissue under this scope. This source scope does not validate any gate-to-tissue association.
